newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Motor to post record profit in 97/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Honda Motor to post record profit in 97/98 - paper.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd's group net profit is expected to hit a record high of 245 billion yen in the year to March 1998, up 11 percent from its estimated profit in the previous year, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said over the weekend.
A spokesman for the company declined to comment on the report.
The expected increase in profit is mainly due to a rise in sales in the domestic and overseas markets as well as the weaker yen, the paper said.
The company will likely increase its annual dividend payment to 16 yen per share in 1997/98, up one yen from the previous year, the paper said.
The company will announce its earnings results for 1996/97 as well as its forecast for 1997/98 on May 20.
